slices.goal: Preserve the work domain on every relevant long-lived record where the authoritative contract supports it (room, source, project, run, task, command, notification, standing work, release, audit chain) and enable per-lane history and search filtering (§10). Filtering is a convenience projection over existing records and never reconstructs authority: an index is never a truth store, results retain their source mode (SHOWROOM/LIVE/DEGRADED/UNAVAILABLE) and their canonical identifiers, and a record whose domain the contract does not carry shows — rather than a guessed lane.
authorityPrerequisites: an index is never authority; SNAPSHOT_WINS applies to every search result that carries a canonical claim
a record with no contract-supported work domain renders — and is never assigned a lane by inference
slices.empiricalReview: Negative controls, each observed FAILING: a lane filter inferring a domain the record does not carry; index state overriding the current snapshot; a lane filter silently hiding records instead of reporting an unknown domain; a showroom result presented without its source mode after filtering.

slices.title: lane-aware notifications
slices.goal: Make notifications lane-legible (§10): 'SYSTEM: S13 blocked on S5.' versus 'CUSTOMER: Nisses Måleri post-deploy smoke failed.' — never collapsed into one generic task-failed UX. A notification whose work domain is unknown states that honestly rather than defaulting to a lane. Notification delivery, acknowledgement and resolution semantics remain owned by NOTIFICATION-01; this slice adds the domain distinction, and remote attention is still never remote authority.
authorityPrerequisites: a notification is attention, never authority, and never a promotion or state mutation
an unknown work domain is stated as unknown and never defaulted to a lane
slices.empiricalReview: Negative controls, each observed FAILING: a customer post-deploy smoke failure and a control-plane dependency block collapsing into the same generic task-failed notification; a notification with an unknown domain labelled SYSTEM or CUSTOMER anyway; a notification implying an authoritative promotion or state change.

slices.title: lane-aware Slack/remote UX
slices.targetRepository: Nortropic-owned Slack app/bot ('Nortropic Tag') plus the remote operator interface
slices.goal: Carry the same lane distinction into remote UX (§9): Nortropic Slack supports '@nortropic status customer' / '@nortropic status system' (or an equivalent such as '@nortropic vad bygger vi åt kunder?' / 'vad förbättrar Nortropic just nu?'). Remote command and status responses carry the ACTUAL work domain or —, never a guessed one. One room/context architecture may span both domains, and context and search retain domain identity across the remote surface. Remote responses remain read/observe plus narrow typed intents; a remote message is never authority.
authorityPrerequisites: a remote response reports state, never establishes it; remote attention is not remote authority
a remote status response never guesses the work domain: unknown renders —
slices.empiricalReview: Negative controls, each observed FAILING: 'status customer' returning control-plane work; a remote status response inventing a work domain when the source publishes none; a remote reply presented as an authoritative promotion; context or search losing domain identity when reached from the remote surface.
remotePrerequisites: REMOTE-01 shell operational: a Slack workspace plus the Nortropic-owned Slack app provisioned by the owner
no Anthropic entitlement of any kind is required: ANTHROPIC_CLAUDE_TAG_REQUIRED=NO

slices.title: live controller work-domain projection
slices.goal: Replace the showroom-carried work domain with the live controller-published value once the backend publishes it (§3, §14): the UX shape established by LANE-01..LANE-04 must not require redesign. Live UI never guesses the domain, a missing live value renders —, and SYSTEM_IMPROVEMENT is never inferred from a repository name unless a frozen controller-owned projection explicitly authorizes that derivation. The projection is read-only and controller-owned: CONTROLLER_LOCAL_STATE=SOLE_AUTHORITY and SNAPSHOT_WINS are unchanged by this slice.
authorityPrerequisites: nortropic-system S5 (controller/handelse) frozen and built
nortropic-system S13 (controller/lucka) frozen and built
the controller publishes a typed work domain, and schema/transport compatibility with the consuming read-model is proven before the live half is claimed
the work domain is never derived client-side from a repository name or any other heuristic
slices.empiricalReview: Against a real publishing controller: a snapshot that omits the work domain is observed rendering — rather than a stale or guessed lane; a deliberately conflicting tail event is observed losing to the snapshot; and the live lane value is observed matching the controller projection rather than any client-side derivation.

slices.title: domain-specific verification profiles
slices.goal: Express the two domain verification profiles over the SHARED trust machinery (§8): both lanes reuse task/attempt/workspace/candidate/policy/gate/review/attestation/promotion/audit (SHARED_TRUST_KERNEL_BETWEEN_LANES=YES). SYSTEM_IMPROVEMENT emphasizes frozen task gates, controller invariants, provider identity, trust boundaries, regression tests and Nortropic-repo publication. CUSTOMER_PRODUCTION emphasizes build/typecheck, visual/responsive, accessibility, SEO, business/contact data, no-secret/client-leak, preview, domain/config, deployment and post-deploy smoke. Website QA semantics are never forced onto control-plane tasks, and customer production is never reduced to generic code gates. A profile is a presentation of which checks matter per lane; it never becomes a second trust kernel and never grants or withholds authority.
authorityPrerequisites: a verification profile is presentational and never a second trust kernel, policy engine or attestation path
profiles never relax, replace or synthesize a gate result; a gate result comes only from its source
slices.empiricalReview: Negative controls, each observed FAILING: SEO or responsive checks demanded of a control-plane task; a customer website task reduced to generic code gates with no visual, accessibility or smoke expectation; a profile synthesizing a gate verdict its source never produced; a second parallel trust kernel introduced per lane.

productRequirements.title: event-driven wakeups
productRequirements.liveEvidence: PARTIAL, measured by reading scripts/claude-loop/autopilot.ts at ac2ba4ea…: SUPERVISOR-01 landed watchForReadyWork (git log -S watchForReadyWork = 4967ba2, merged in 851c0b25… which is an ancestor of this run's base), a bounded POLL-based wakeup primitive. It blocks until there is something to wake up for and then exits, returning wake='READY' (any ready slice, or one named slice) or wake='RUN_TERMINAL' (a watched run reached a terminal phase) or wake='TIMEOUT'. It explicitly takes no claim, writes no state, starts no run, chooses between no slices and re-invokes nothing; its timeout is mandatory so it can never become an unattended daemon. Covered by tests/claude-loop/supervisor-async-ownership.test.ts. The measured REMAINING gap is therefore narrow and specific: a wake driven by a CONTROLLER EVENT rather than by an elapsed poll interval. It is not 'no wakeup exists'.
